EIGHTH ARMY · ITALIAN CAMPAIGN · DECEMBER 1943
ORTONA
Eight days of close fighting in a rain-soaked Adriatic town. Lead the 1st Canadian Infantry Division into Ortona or hold its shattered streets with the veteran paratroopers of 1. Fallschirmjäger-Division.
URBAN GROUNDStone walls, rubble and shell holes decide firefights. Cross streets are killing grounds.
ENFILADELinear cover protects across its face. Fire down its length strips two grades of protection.
OBJECTIVETake the piazza and the three victory sectors. Cut-off sectors stop producing resources.
GROUND OPPOSITION SIDES VICTORY ENEMY GUNS
HANDICAPyour own side of it. The opposition above is set on its own, so a veteran opponent can be fought on any economy you like.
OPPOSITIONthe same settings turned on each computer player, up or down, on top of whatever GREEN, REGULAR or VETERAN already says. A veteran brain on half an economy, or a green one with a real army. In a 2v2 there are three of them and each is set on its own.
